title: Noise preprocessing and the noise operator
statement: Let $C$ be a sign query check, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube taking values in $[-1,1]$. The value of $C$ after independently applying noise with correlation $1-\delta$ to its queries and then evaluating $f$ equals the randomized value of $C$ on the function obtained by applying the noise operator with correlation $1-\delta$ to $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a sign query check on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
